description.value: Waffleland Café is an all-day waffle restaurant in Vancouver's Gastown Historic District, specializing in artisanal Belgian Liège waffles and Norwegian waffles with both sweet and savory variations. The interior is themed around Alice in Wonderland, blending lush greenery with storybook-inspired décor for a distinctive dining atmosphere. A cocktail and beverage menu accompanies the food, making it a memorable food stop in one of Vancouver's most bikeable historic neighbourhoods.
